1240992.name: braces
1240992.title: braces vulnerable to stack-exhaustion denial of service through deeply nested patterns
1240992.reason: No patched version of braces available as of 2026-10-20 — every published version (<=3.0.3) is affected
1240992.impact: braces is only reached through gh-pages (globby → fast-glob → micromatch), a dev dependency used by the deploy step to publish dist/ with globs from our own config, never on user input, and it is not part of the built docs site.
1240992.wayForward: Wait for braces to publish a release above 3.0.3 (or for gh-pages/globby to drop it), then run npm audit fix and remove this acknowledgement
